title: Warm Velvety Dutch Cabbage Gratin
description: A savory and velvety Dutch dish featuring cabbage, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a Mediterranean twist. This meal-prep friendly recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the shredded cabbage to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is tender and lightly browned.
Transfer the cabbage mixture to a baking dish and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, combine the heavy cream, salt, black pepper, and nutmeg, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the cream sauce by half and stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
Pour the cream sauce over the cabbage mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the baking dish to the oven and bake for 20 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
Remove the dish from the oven and broil for an additional 2 minutes, until the top is crispy and caramelized.
